Diverticulosis
Diverticulosis is a disorder of the colon, most often the sigmoid colon, caused by 
multiple potential factors including age-related changes in the colonic wall, abnormal 
increases in colonic intraluminal pressure, and motor dysfunction. Inadequate fiber 
intake is thought to increase the risk for the development of diverticulosis.56 The 
­incidence of diverticulosis increases with age. The prevalence of diverticular disease 
has been reported at 10% of the population, most often occurring after age 40. It has
